title: Tropical Storm Florence National Guard Relief Operations
description: U.S. Army National Guard UH-60 Black Hawk helicopters along with CH-47 Chinook helicopters from multiple states support relief and search and rescue operations in the aftermath of Tropical Storm Florence from the South Carolina National Guard Army Aviation Support Facility at McEntire Joint National Guard Base, South Carolina, September 17, 2018. More than 3,400 South Carolina National Guard Airmen and Soldiers have been mobilized to prepare, respond and participate in recovery efforts as as Tropical Storm Florence caused flooding and damage to the state. (U.S. Air National Guard video by Master Sgt. Caycee Watson)
